Observe is the first WHAT skill: intentionally notice sensations, thoughts, emotions, and events as they arise.

## Observe {#observe}
## Source / Printable Copies

- [Observe source pages](/resources/mindfulness/mindfulness-observe-source.pdf)

## Text Version / Adapted Text

The WHAT skills describe what you do in mindfulness: **observe**, **describe**, and **participate**. They can be practised separately or together.

### Observe {#observe}

Attend to sensations, thoughts, feelings, and events as they occur. Notice the experience without immediately pushing it away, holding onto it, or turning it into a conclusion.

[Grounding](/learn/mindfulness/grounding.html) applies observation to present sensory and body information, and the [Grounding tool](/tool-finder/grounding/) provides a concise guided practice.
